_help: Cards for the 'Merch' section. Add a product: name, blurb, price (as shown on Teemill), image (put it in assets/merch/), url (the Teemill product page), cta. Newest first. Items can have a 'group' (heading shown above the first item of each group). Scouse Edition items whose url is just the shop have no live Teemill page yet: set url to https://smokeroach.teemill.com/product/<teemillSlug>/ and cta to 'Buy now' once live.
